title: Serverless API Best Practices
description: Build scalable APIs using Azure Functions with HTTP triggers and API Management.

data.text: You need to expose 12 HTTP endpoints for a mobile app backend. Traffic is unpredictable (0-10,000 requests/minute). You need throttling, caching, authentication, and monitoring. How do you build this serverlessly?
Use **Azure Functions with HTTP triggers** for the API endpoints. Put **Azure API Management** in front for throttling, caching, and authentication. Enable **Application Insights** for monitoring.

data.title: Azure Function - HTTP Trigger with Auth
ARM Template - API Management Policy
data.code:
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <rate-limit calls="100" renewal-period="60" />
    <cache-lookup vary-by-developer="true" />
    <check-header header="Authorization" exists="true" />
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <base />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
n    <base />
    <cache-store duration="300" />
  </outbound>
</policies>

data.text: **Functions + APIM** is the gold standard for serverless APIs on Azure. APIM handles cross-cutting concerns (auth, throttling, caching) while Functions handle business logic. This separation keeps functions focused.
